messages.subject: Shiny app internationalization
parts:
Hi,

I just wanted to know if there is a way to translate shiny apps into different languages based on the current system locale. I know how to do it with po files for package messages, but I wonder if there could be a similar mechanism for shiny apps.

Thanks a lot for this wonderful framework.

Julien
